caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a painted religious icon or retablo, featuring a single male figure standing in the center. The figure wears a black crown or headdress, a robe in shades of tan, beige, and red, with black sleeves and a red stole draped over his shoulder. The man's right hand is raised and holds a black cross, while his left hand is positioned at his chest. The background is a muted gold-brown with red accents, framed by a red border with wavy and scalloped outlines. At the top of the rectangular object, a white or beige cord or ribbon is attached, tied in a loop and extending upward. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the text "MAJEL C. CLAFLIN — TAOS, N.M." The rest of the background is plain and off-white.
title: Retablo
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
